description: This file defines the ThreadRAII class in the Utils namespace, which manages a std::thread object with RAII semantics, ensuring thread join on destruction and supporting move semantics.

classes.name: ThreadRAII
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for std::thread that joins the thread upon destruction, supports move semantics, and provides access to the underlying thread.

methods.name: ThreadRAII(std::thread&& t)
methods.description: Constructor that takes an rvalue reference to a std::thread and takes ownership.

methods.name: ~ThreadRAII()
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if joinable, with exception handling.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the managed std::thread.
